Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Scandinavian Task Lamp, 19"H, Matte Black
Colors: Black
This nifty matte-black table lamp has a slim stem, a hooded shade, and contrasting accents—a modern design with vintage flair. Better yet, it comes with a useful USB port on the base. Talk about stylish and convenient! This table lamp is made out of metal and wood. This lamp comes with a useful USB port. This lamp has a modern design with classic touches that make it neatly blend with any room. 6"W x 6"D x 19"H Simple assembly in 15-30 minutes This lamp comes with a bulb and is rated for indoor use.
